sgwt.fitted.fitted_vf module

main.py

Will be abstracted eventually. Core class for now, implementing the VF version of the SGWT.

Author: Luke Lowery (lukel@tamu.edu)

class sgwt.fitted.fitted_vf.VectorFitSGWT(L, kern=None)[source]

Bases: object

Description:

A class that computes rational-approximation approach to the SGWT and various analytical versions of filters.

Parameters:

  • L (csc_matrix) – sparse csc_matrix form of Graph Laplacian (real valued)

  • kern (VFKernelData) – optional, VF data of spectral function
